confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of UK city-centre pricing, not from live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak visitor season and nightly rates vary widely. FX: the 2026-10-16 RBA value came from a search-index summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly, so verify it against the RBA F11 table. Aggregator sites showed roughly 0.693 for 1 October 2026, which is broadly consistent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to mid-sized UK regional cities such as Glasgow and Manchester, with a similar leisure-visitor market and a city-centre accommodation mix. Accommodation anchors reflect July peak-season pricing.
